# Vendored parser

`abc_tools.py` is a pinned copy of the strict ABC parser used by the
**arabmaqamrock** dialect (two voices `Vocal`/`Ins`, chord symbols in double
quotes, `L:1/32` units, no `[]` chords, no repeat barlines).

Upstream: <https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/tree/main/skills/yue2-music/instrumental>
License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

It is vendored so this repository is self-contained: `tools/abc_to_musicxml.py`
and its tests run with a plain `python3`, no pip install and no clone of the
parent project.

**Do not edit this file here.** Fixes belong in the parent project's
`plumbing/yue2_instrumental/abc_tools.py` and are copied over afterwards.
